background_notes.fact: If g_1,...,g_m generate J as an R-module and R⊂Q, then g_1,...,g_m span QJ=span_Q J over Q. In particular QJ has finite dimension.

R is the specified subring of Q.
QJ is the rational span of J.

background_notes.justification: Every element of J is an R-linear combination of the generators, hence a rational combination. Substituting into a finite rational combination proves the spanning assertion. Successively discard each generator lying in the span of its predecessors; the retained finite list is independent and still spans, hence is a finite basis.

background_notes.fact: For an R-linear map g:U→W and a commutative R-algebra Q, the balanced rule q⊗u↦q⊗g(u) defines a Q-linear map Q⊗_R U→Q⊗_R W. Such tensor products are generated over Q by pure tensors, so two Q-linear maps agreeing on pure tensors agree everywhere.

background_notes.justification: The proposed rule is additive in each factor and respects (qa)⊗u=q⊗(au) because g(au)=ag(u); the tensor universal property supplies the map. A tensor product is constructed from finite sums of pure tensors modulo the bilinearity and balancing relations. Consequently checking each composite on pure tensors and extending by linearity proves S004's inverse identities.

background_notes.fact: A vector space over Q with a finite spanning set has a finite basis; the cardinality of any finite basis is its dimension, and a linear isomorphism preserves that dimension. Moreover an injective Q-linear map Q^a→Q^b forces a≤b, so Q satisfies the strong rank condition required by M003.

background_notes.justification: Pruning a finite spanning list gives a basis. Gaussian elimination over a field shows that an independent list in the span of b vectors has at most b members: each pivot uses a distinct one of the b rows. Applying this in both directions to finite bases proves equality of their sizes. An isomorphism carries a basis to a basis. Under an injection Q^a→Q^b, the images of the a standard basis vectors are independent, so elimination yields a≤b. Finite bases also directly establish freeness and finite generation used in M003.
